jobs.SUPPORT: Takes in the customer's order and sends the proforma invoice
jobs.PRODUCT_MANAGER: Watches stock and run rate, and raises the request to buy

welcome.title: One sales order, six teams
welcome.body: This tour follows the sales flow on the sample data, one team at a time. At each step the button to press is lit. At the end the tour puts the data back.

flows.title: Nine steps for every sales order
flows.body: Every order moves through these steps, from the customer's PO to the shipping documents. Each step belongs to one team.

review.title: Support checks what the AI read
review.body: The AI has read a customer's PO. A person checks the fields before anything is used. Click Review.

journey.title: The order's journey
journey.body: One view shows where the order stands, who has it, and when each step was done. Press Next to go to the product manager.

raise.title: The product manager raises an SPR
raise.body: Stock is short, so OrderPilot suggests a stock purchase requisition from stock on hand and the 3-month sales rate. A person decides to raise it. Click Raise.

openSpr.title: The approver opens an SPR
openSpr.body: Any one of three management approvers decides. Click Review to open the most overdue request, one raised earlier.

refused.title: A decision needs a reason
refused.body: Click Approve without writing a comment. OrderPilot refuses: every decision says why.

comment.title: Say why
comment.body: Type a short reason in the comment box, such as "Under a month of cover". Then press Next.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: Click Approve. The decision is recorded with who, when and why, and the order moves on in the workflow.

history.title: Every step is recorded
history.body: The history shows the request, who it went to, and the decision. The audit trail keeps it too.

sendPi.title: Support sends the PI
sendPi.body: With stock in place, Support sends the customer the pro forma invoice. Click Mark sent.

payment.title: Finance confirms the payment
payment.body: Nothing ships until Finance confirms the customer's prepayment. Click Confirm.

pack.title: The warehouse packs
pack.body: Once the order is paid, the warehouse picks and packs it. Click Mark packed.

ship.title: Logistics adds the shipping documents
ship.body: Logistics adds the air waybill once the goods are with the forwarder. Click Mark added.

reminders.title: Nobody has to chase
reminders.body: A late task gets a reminder, then passes up if nobody acts. The SPR approved a moment ago has already left this list.

finish.title: That is the sales flow
finish.body: Press Finish to put the sample data back, ready for the next run.

tour.switchBody: Open Demo role at the top right and choose {{role}}. The tour carries on as soon as you do.
tour.puttingBack: Putting back what this team did, so the next run starts the same. One moment.
